summary: Dependency-confusion beacon exfiltrates host identifiers on npm install
details: Package version 9999.0.0 ships a hollow index.js and a preinstall.js that runs automatically on `npm install`. The preinstall script collects hostname, username, cwd, install path, platform, Node version, and npm user-agent, then transmits them via a DNS lookup to the hardcoded interactsh subdomain dae7n4pijsh1ahi9684gu8get3kaiefc9.oast.online and via HTTP(S) POST to the bare IP 5.189.159.252. The internal-sounding name combined with the 9999.0.0 version is the standard dependency-confusion shape: any build system that resolves this name from the public registry beacons its host/user identifiers to third-party infrastructure. A self-label as a bug-bounty/research probe does not obtain installer consent and the destinations are not controlled by the installer's organization.
